observation: Stages 1-3 are healthy for a t4&5 complex scan: recentre residual 2.1 cm (gate 10 cm), orient_invariant_ok=1 with |corr|=0.77, depth_nan_ratio 0.198 (family-normal 19-22%), denoise_retained_ratio 0.77, and exactly 10 Hough verticals for 10 rings (ring_count_error 0). The weak link is detection->segmentation coherence: correspondence_f1@15 is only 0.467, det_real_detection_ratio 0.7 / det_fallback_ratio 0.3 with 10 prompt points of which 3 are 'assume' and 3 are 'midpoint' fallbacks, and detected_lines.png shows only ~9 oblique lines (6 positive, 3 negative) against a wall of blue horizontal fallback lines. In the outlier map the tapered block joints are visible but as faint dotted traces, so oblique HoughLinesP is starving. The SC overlay shows many red (unsupported) label boundaries and several orange joint lines around the real oblique detections, and sam_segment_size_cv is 1.11: prompt-centre y positions jump between columns, so SAM templates land off the true K/A/B pattern even though ring completeness is 1.0 and fill rate (0.76) is essentially 1-NaN.
rule: Ontology d7 (m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered -> f_missing_lines) with remediation r_relax_hough (lower oblique threshold, raise maxLineGap), precondition satisfied because upstream f_joint_oversmoothed/f_depth_holes are ruled out (joints visible, NaN family-normal, residual < 10 cm). d8/r_fix_height_priors: relax pattern_tolerance so real intersections pass check_distance_pattern instead of degrading to midpoint/assume. Experiences s5 (5-1: oblique 35 px with ring-consistent verticals recovered detection) and s7 tuning order (stages 1-3 confirmed healthy, so round 1 may move to detection; SAM geometry deferred until prompts are real).
failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (oblique yield too low -> horizontal/assume fallback) cascading to stage_4.f_pattern_mismatch and stage_5.f_crop_offset (mis-placed prompt centres -> label boundaries unsupported by joint lines, low correspondence F1, high segment-size CV).
rationale: Anchor proxy 0.692 sits just under the accept band (>=0.7); the lean feature that is far from healthy is correspondence_f1@15 (0.467), which is driven by prompt-centre placement, not by coverage. Keep the healthy stages frozen (no unfolding since stage1 is locked; denoising and enhancing left at anchor values so NaN/retention are unchanged and attribution stays clean) and make one coordinated detection move: lower binary_threshold 127->110 so the faint dotted joint pixels survive binarisation, lower hough_threshold_oblique to 35 and raise maxLineGap_oblique to 65 so the dotted tapered joints link into oblique segments instead of falling through to horizontal fallback, and set pattern_tolerance to 15 px so genuine K/AB-pattern intersections are accepted over midpoint/assume fallbacks. Verticals are left alone because 10 lines already equal the ring count. Expected signature: det_real_detection_ratio up from 0.7 toward 1.0, fewer 'assume'/'midpoint' prompts, correspondence_f1@15 up, sam_segment_size_cv down, with depth_nan_ratio and ring_count_error unchanged. If oblique yield rises but boundaries still miss, round 2 should turn to SAM geometry (K_height / angle).
